verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll is a SaaS product that handles sensitive employee data and markets AI features ('Payroll AI'), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented control, policy, or setting that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. The AI marketing copy describes data collection, not training opt-outs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
